observed_constraints: Internal CBMCall carries site_start_byte/site_end_byte. Sequential and parallel CALLS properties retain line, callee, confidence, strategy and candidate count, omitting those spans.
Unresolved ordinary calls continue without a callsite record in parallel resolution; sequential processing retains an aggregate unresolved counter.
Candidate count/heuristic confidence is not a candidate target set or proof of exact binding. A missing edge cannot distinguish absent call from unresolved call.
Reconstructing every site from a separate source parser would make that parser the fact owner; it does not qualify this pin as the complete evidence store.

lifecycle.configuration_boundary: A unique CBM_RUNTIME_DIR scopes rendezvous/cohort/project locks on POSIX, plus separate CBM_CACHE_DIR and XDG_CONFIG_HOME. HOME/cache alone do not scope coordination. Default MCP, async index, install/update/uninstall and daemon control are excluded.

lifecycle.assessment: Finite parse/export and fixed-script modes are source-supported with an owned workspace and explicit outputs. Runtime isolation, coexistence, cancellation and cleanup have not been qualified; exact Go asset notice binding blocks the build before executable use.

cancellation.required_proof: Enforce approved resource/wall/output limits outside the CLI, cancel only its owned process group/cgroup, reap every child and prove no owned descendants survive. No daemon manager or account-wide process stopping is authorized.
cancellation.source_constraint: ExternalCommand defaults to Duration.Inf. Its finite timeout calls process.destroy on one child and does not demonstrate descendant cancellation/reaping.

cleanup.required_proof: Verify cleanup on normal completion, failure and cancellation within the private roots; distinguish retained reviewed artifacts from disposable runtime files. Do not claim script hooks or finally establish cleanup after forced termination.
cleanup.source_support: Script runAfter closes workspace projects; export closes the CPG through Using.resource; ExternalCommand deletes its stdout/stderr temp files in finally.

coexistence.required_proof: Run only an owned finite process group or cgroup after setup approval. Record scoped process/path/resource state before and after, prove existing sessions and caches remain unaffected, and never signal or reconfigure unowned processes.

finite_cli_boundary: joern-parse accepts explicit language/output and terminates the batch; joern-export uses an explicit new owned output directory and Using.resource around the loaded CPG.

BridgeBase selects runScript when --script is present; its parser describes execute-and-exit. Pass trusted fixed script arguments with repeated --param key=value. The reviewed mode excludes server, interactive shell, plugin management and arbitrary startup/dependency options.

The default Console workspace is baseDir/workspace, with baseDir defaulting to the current working directory. Each invocation must use a fresh owned working directory; a fixed script may switch only to a verified owned workspace.
isolated_configuration_and_caches: InstallConfig supports SHIFTLEFT_OCULAR_INSTALL_DIR; set it to the exact private distribution so install-root discovery cannot choose an ambient installation through its classpath/current-directory parent scan.

Before any future executable use, provide an explicit child environment and private JVM user.home/java.io.tmpdir, user/config/cache/temp roots and Coursier cache. The approved build also requires private sbt boot/global/Ivy directories. Verify actual resolved paths and writes; these confinement settings are prerequisites, not measured support or isolation proof.

Use explicit hash-pinned ASTGEN_BIN/GOASTGEN_BIN or a restricted private tool path. Never resolve sidecars through ambient PATH. Go dependency fetching remains disabled; no project compiler/package-manager environment or account configuration is shared.

The experiment therefore requires an isolated child process group/cgroup, enforced wall/RSS/output limits, cancellation of only that group, reaping, and no descendants after cancellation.
query.full_export_boundary: GraphSON whole-graph export is only allowed for the finite locked fixture with a separately enforced output-file cap; it is not a bounded query proof.
